tools.name: ask_hotel
tools.description: Ask a VibeBooking hotel a question its published facts may answer: parking, wifi, luggage, check-in, children, getting there. outcome answered gives the hotel's own text in answer, to quote as written; unanswered means the hotel has not published one, and the question has been sent to it, so say so

tools.name: book_link
tools.description: The booking link for a stay when you have no offer from get_rates (for example, get_rates could not be read): it re-checks the stay live and opens the hotel's booking page. When you have an offer, give its booking_url instead. Nothing is booked, held or paid here: the traveller books and pays on the

tools.name: get_hotel
tools.description: A VibeBooking hotel's published facts, with no dates needed: name, address, check-in and cancellation terms, images and its room types (rooms[].ref, name, max_occupancy, size_m2 and each room's own facts). With room, a ref from rooms[].ref, one room type's page instead. hotel is the id from search_h

tools.name: get_rates
tools.description: Live rates for a stay at a VibeBooking hotel. The answer's first part is our stay, status, read time and next step. Its data block follows, also available as structuredContent.data: offers[], each self-contained and in the order to present — room, plan, the whole-stay total, any tax to pay at the pr

tools.name: resolve_hotel
tools.description: Call this whenever the user gives you, or your web search finds, a hotel's website. Pass its domain or URL. tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Search VibeBooking's registry of independent hotels and inns in Japan by destination area: a city, ward, district or station name as it appears in a hotel's address (日本語 or English, e.g. 京都市東山区, Gion, 河原町). This is where the traveller wants to stay, not where they are. The registry is small and grow

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "ask_hotel" stacks urgency/override words (urgent, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: resolve_hotel · Public sink: resolve_hotel.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: resolve_hotel · Public sink: resolve_hotel

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "book_link" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
